stories.label: Syria three-front crisis — al-Hol mass escape adds to Assad remnant and IS threats
stories.summary: Syria now fighting on three fronts: regime remnants in Latakia, IS insurgents in the east, and thousands of IS-linked families escaped from al-Hol detention camp. Kurdish guards redeployed, camp effectively unguarded. New government unable to secure peace three months after toppling Assad.

stories.label: Myanmar junta bombs Rakhine village market, killing 17 including women and children
stories.summary: Military air strikes killed 17 at a village market in Rakhine state. Arakan Army fighting junta while Rohingya trapped between both forces. Same region as the Rohingya genocide — war continues with minimal international attention.

stories.label: Zimbabwe bans all raw mineral and lithium exports
stories.summary: Zimbabwe imposed immediate ban on export of all raw minerals and lithium concentrate, including minerals in transit. Africa's largest lithium reserves. Chinese firms are primary buyers. Assertion of resource sovereignty with global battery supply chain implications.

stories.label: Thousands clash with police in Manila on EDSA 40th anniversary
stories.summary: Thousands protested corruption on 40th anniversary of People Power Revolution that toppled Marcos Sr. His son, President Marcos Jr., now faces the same democratic anger. Clashes with police in Manila.

stories.label: Sickle cell gene therapy — $2.2M cure inaccessible in Africa where disease kills most
stories.summary: Casgevy gene therapy cures sickle cell but costs $2.2M per patient. 80% of cases in sub-Saharan Africa. Uganda began mandatory newborn screening this month. Pharmaceutical inequality made concrete.

stories.label: FBI subpoenas X for Grok prompts used to create 200+ deepfake harassment videos
stories.summary: FBI obtained Grok AI prompts via subpoena to X in harassment case. Over 200 nonconsensual sexual videos generated. First known case of law enforcement using legal process to get AI prompts as evidence.

stories.label: US orders diplomats to fight data sovereignty initiatives worldwide
stories.summary: State Department ordered diplomats to oppose data localization laws worldwide. Benefits US tech giants at the expense of nations trying to control their citizens' data. India, Indonesia, Nigeria, Brazil among targets.

stories.label: Sudan war — Hemedti linked to Dubai property portfolio, UNSC sanctions commanders
stories.summary: UNSC sanctioned four RSF/SAF commanders. MEE investigation links Hemedti to Dubai property portfolio — war profiteering while Sudan burns. Not covered this cycle — no major new development beyond last cycle's UNSC story.

stories.label: Iran crisis — Round 3 talks underway in Geneva, military buildup continues
stories.summary: Round 3 talks underway in Geneva. Pezeshkian strikes hopeful tone. Trump SOTU reiterated military threat. Iran regime cracking down on student protests. Australia ordering diplomats' families out of Israel/Lebanon. Not covered this cycle — threshold requires outcome.

stories.label: Pentagon threatens Anthropic with Cold War-era powers over military AI
stories.summary: Pentagon gave Anthropic Friday deadline to agree to unrestricted military AI use or face Defense Production Act. Outcome expected Friday Feb 27.

stories.label: Pakistan multi-front crisis deepens — KSE-100 4th straight crash, 34 terrorists killed
stories.summary: KSE-100 crashed again (4th straight day, down 1,600 points). 34 terrorists killed in KP and Balochistan. CPJ and 17 groups warned of media freedom deterioration. Approaching systemic crisis convergence.

stories.label: Israeli forces fired 900+ bullets killing 15 Gaza medics execution-style
stories.summary: Forensic investigation found Israeli soldiers fired 900+ bullets at aid workers, killing 15 execution-style. CPJ confirms Israel killed 86 journalists in 2025 — most by any country for second year.

stories.label: Israel orders 37 aid organizations to halt operations in Gaza and West Bank
stories.summary: 37 aid groups ordered to halt all operations. Aid groups now petitioning Israeli court to reverse bans. Connected to medics massacre and systematic dismantling of humanitarian access.

stories.label: Sri Lanka arrests ex-intelligence chief over 2019 Easter bombings
stories.summary: Former intelligence chief arrested over the 2019 Easter Sunday bombings that killed 279. Seven years of impunity broken.

stories.label: 6.5 million in Somalia face severe hunger as drought deepens
stories.summary: UN reports 6.5 million Somalis face severe hunger. Drought compounded by Al-Shabaab blocking aid and US funding freezes.

stories.label: Singapore publishes wealth distribution data for first time
stories.summary: Singapore reveals richest 1% own 14% of assets — lower than US or UK. First-ever publication of wealth data.

stories.label: WiseTech cuts 2,000 jobs as AI replaces software engineers
stories.summary: WiseTech cutting one-third of workforce explicitly attributing layoffs to AI replacing manual coding.

stories.label: South Africa retrieves 11 men lured into Russia's Ukraine war
stories.summary: South Africa secured return of 11 men lured into Russia-Ukraine war. Part of broader Russian recruitment from Global South.

stories.label: Ukraine-Russia war — year 5 grinds on
stories.summary: War grinds into year 5. No major new development this cycle.

stories.label: Japan to deploy missiles on island 110km from Taiwan by 2031
stories.summary: Japan deploying missiles to Yonaguni island, 110km from Taiwan, by 2031.

stories.label: Amazon accused of systematic scheme to inflate prices across economy
stories.summary: Investigation reveals Amazon operating systematic scheme to inflate prices. Watch for FTC/DOJ follow-up.

stories.label: US tells Afghan allies to give up — 173-year resettlement backlog
stories.summary: DHS admits 173-year processing backlog. 180,000 Afghans in pipeline.

stories.label: Lebanon army ordered to respond after Israeli fire on military post
stories.summary: Lebanese Army authorized to return fire. Watch for actual engagement.

stories.label: Israel targets press — 86 journalists killed in 2025 (CPJ)
stories.summary: CPJ annual report confirms Israel killed 86 journalists in 2025 — most by any country for second year. Record 129 journalists killed globally. Multiple sources carrying this today.

stories.label: US tariff upheaval — Section 122 tariffs in effect
stories.summary: No major new development. Fading.

stories.label: Thai and Cambodian armies exchange fire at disputed border
stories.summary: Ammunition depot explosion at Thai border patrol facility. Situation unresolved.

stories.label: China-Japan export war / US chip control regime under pressure
stories.summary: German chancellor Merz visiting China — trade focus. Export control tensions continue.

stories.label: Stripe reportedly in talks to acquire PayPal
stories.summary: Bloomberg report only. Would be one of largest fintech deals ever.

stories.label: Brazil floods kill 28+ in Minas Gerais
stories.summary: Death toll rising to 30+. Rescuers still searching. Same La Niña pattern driving Horn of Africa drought.

stories.label: ICC prosecution: Duterte drew up 'death lists' for drug war
stories.summary: ICC hearing moving into procedural phase.

stories.label: Mexico CJNG crisis — aftermath of El Mencho death
stories.summary: Situation reportedly stabilized. 70+ killed in aftermath.

stories.label: Mercury 2 diffusion-based LLM challenges autoregressive AI paradigm
stories.summary: Inception Labs' diffusion-based LLM. Awaiting independent verification.

stories.label: Russia opens criminal case against Telegram founder Durov
stories.summary: Both France and Russia pursuing criminal cases against Durov.
